Sam O: Quick consolidation from the postmortem - we need a tight action tracker for the DR failover items before the next rehearsal. Who can own what?
Ruth Q: I'll own the routing resilience changes (weights + graceful ramp). Will draft the terraform diff.
Devon P: I'll own snapshot checkpoints and restore timing. Will run restores with netem to capture RTO under degraded network. ETA Wed.
Sam O: Good. Also we must add a cache-warm preflight to stop cold-KV storms. Can someone own priming + health check?
Ruth Q: I can do the priming script and a short verification step. Snippet for runbook: ```bash
# prime top keys
python prime_kv.py --region ap-southeast --top 8000 --concurrency 12
python kv_check.py --region ap-southeast --window 300 --min-hit 0.82
```
Devon P: For snapshots I'll add checksum validation and idempotency tests to avoid duplicate manifests. Posting results to INFR-999.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2024-07-20 09:00 UTC "DR: preflight smoke"
ops-bot: Calendar event created: 2024-07-22 14:00 UTC "DR rehearsal: routing canary + restore smoke"
Sam O: Deadlines: routing PR by Mon EOD, priming script + healthcheck by Tue, snapshot runs Wed, smoke Thu AM. Owners recap: routing - Ruth; snapshots - Devon; preflight script - Ruth.
Ruth Q: I'll open PR and add a canary pipeline: 5% -> 25% after 20m -> 75% after 1h -> full after 3h. Reject conditions: error-rate >1% or KV-hit <75%.
Devon P: Will upload restore artifacts to INFR-999 and link time-series. Also will test restore under packet loss (1%, 2%) and attach RTOs.
Sam O: I'll consolidate into the remediation tracker and create subtasks. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-999
Ruth Q: :thumbsup:
Devon P: :thumbsup:
Sam O: Closing thread for now; will reopen if any ETA slips or tests surface new patterns.
